commands: git fetch -q --tags origin && git tag --sort=-v:refname | head -3

tag=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep '^v' | head -1) && mkdir -p deploy && printf '# standings service: the tally release it deploys. Jonas Weber.
# The deploy checks the tag out and stops unless it resolves to this commit.
tally %s %s
' "$tag" "$(git rev-parse "$tag^{commit}")" > deploy/standings.lock && cat deploy/standings.lock
git add deploy/standings.lock && git commit -q -m "standings: deploy the newest tally release"

printf '# deploy/standings

standings.lock names the tally tag and commit the standings service runs.
Do not move a tag that is named here.
' > deploy/README.md && git add deploy/README.md && git commit -q -m "Say what the lock file is for"
git push -q origin deploy/standings && git log --oneline -2
